name: Buon Choah rice
summary: Rice from Buôn Choáh in Krong No, grown to VietGAP on volcanic soil with mineral-rich water. The grain is fragrant, sticky, and deeply sweet.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022. The handbook spells the commune Buôn Choáh. The portal title spells Buôn Choah.
taste: The tourism portal says the rice is fragrant, sticky, and deeply sweet.
howToEat: The tourism portal credits volcanic soil, the climate, and mineral-rich irrigation water, plus VietGAP growing. Cook it as rice.
where: Xã Buôn Choáh, or Buôn Choah on the tourism portal, Krong No.
seoDescription: Rice from Buôn Choáh in Krong No. The tourism portal says fragrant, sticky, and sweet, grown to VietGAP.
